event: Primary utility power supply failed at the hospital.
Backup generator was stable and essential circuits were restored four minutes after the primary supply failed.
Outage acknowledgement was requested from the inpatient units by radio.
The ICU acknowledged the outage by runner; radio acknowledgement was not confirmed until seven minutes after the request.
Facilities technician arrived at the switch room six minutes after the primary supply failure.
Incident log recorded a facilities response time of two minutes.
Staff completed the emergency medication cold-chain relocation procedure and logged chain of custody.
Improvement action to reduce radio acknowledgement delays was recorded but the owner field was left blank.
